ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 12 of 2011 (as amended), International Companies Act [Cap. 232], Companies (Name Approval) Regulations, and VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook 2018; UBO disclosure is mandatory at incorporation and within 21 days of any change, filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Beneficial Ownership Register.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed notary public in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization in non-Apostille states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Good Standing for any corporate shareholder/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent in the jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for UBOs and crowdfunding escrow account signatories

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU and Pacific regional sanctions lists, and VFSC Prohibited Persons Database before any UBO or key officer appointment; Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) applies to all politically exposed persons with mandatory source-of-funds verification; ongoing transaction monitoring and annual re-screening are required for the regulated equity crowdfunding portal.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: VFSC e-Registry – International Company Name Reservation Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Latin script using English-language characters; any non-Latin transliteration requires a certified Romanization; the legal suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd' is mandatory for an International Company unless a statutory exemption is obtained.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Submit a written appeal to the VFSC Companies Division within 14 calendar days of name rejection; include documentary evidence of the proposed business purpose and any regulatory approvals for sensitive tokens; VFSC issues a review determination within 5 working days; further refusal may be challenged by judicial review petition before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is permissible for an International Company only as a registered agent facility; however, an equity crowdfunding portal holding a VFSC Special License must maintain a physical office in Vanuatu with substantive commercial presence, local compliance staffing, and board oversight; a purely virtual footprint is not acceptable for licensing.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 65% – unannounced physical inspections are probable within the first 12 months of licensing due to the High_Risk_Special_License classification.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222), as amended, ss. 5-10 (registration, certified copy, effect of incorporation), Schedule 1 (registration fees); read with Financial Dealers Act [Cap. 66] for licenced activity
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: VFSC Corporate Registry, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-01 (Application for Registration of an International Company) followed by the Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required under the International Companies Act for an International Company; the constitution may state share capital without par value, and subscription moneys need not be escrowed at incorporation. If the proposed entity later holds an equity crowdfunding licence, the VFSC may impose a separate paid-up capital condition at licensing stage.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the designated subscriber be admitted as one/multiple shareholder(s), and that the issue and allotment of shares set out in the Register of Members be accepted, subject to receipt of consideration. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office established at [Address, Port Vila, Vanuatu] be and is hereby adopted, and the Company Secretary be directed to file the prescribed notice of registered office with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name], [Name] and [Name] be and are hereby appointed as Directors, Company Secretary, and Anti-Money Laundering Compliance Officer, respectively, and that such officers be authorized jointly/singly to execute banking instructions, contracts, and statutory filings. All prior acts of the organizing subscriber are hereby ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Registry - Name Reservation Desk, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-02 (Name Reservation Request) through the VFSC filing portal or in person at the VFSC registry. The proposed name must contain an acceptable corporate suffix such as 'Limited', 'Company' or 'Corporation', must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, and must not imply Government sponsorship. The reservation, once granted, is held for 28 calendar days while incorporation documents are prepared.
required_dossiers: Completed VFSC Form IC-02 Name Reservation Request
Certificate of Availability / name search printout
Statement from the licensed registered agent that the proposed name does not infringe any third-party rights
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, obtain the written objection grounds from the Registrar, amend the proposed name and re-file within 5 business days. A formal appeal against refusal may be submitted to the Registrar under the International Companies Act within 14 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation of Incorporation Documents and Registered Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Vanuatu registered agent. The agent will prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution) under the International Companies Act, complete Form IC-01, collect notarized identity documents, obtain signed consents from the initial directors and company secretary, and confirm the registered office address. The share capital and issued share classes are set out in the constitution. No paid-up funds need be escrowed at this stage.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution)
VFSC Form IC-01 signed by the subscriber(s)
Notarized passport copy of each subscriber, director and company secretary
Consent to act as director and company secretary
Resident Agent's consent and confirmation of appointment
Statement of the intended registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent identifies omissions or notarization defects, correct the execution pages, ensure the beneficial ownership declaration required by VFSC is complete, and have all parties re-execute the corrected pages before submission. Any materially amended document must be initialled by each signatory.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgement and Payment of Statutory Fees to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registrar of International Companies - Filing Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent lodges the signed Form IC-01, constitution and supporting dossiers to the VFSC together with the statutory filing fee of USD 350. Payment is accepted by bank draft or VFSC-approved electronic transfer quoting the client reference. The agent must retain the VFSC receipt and the file acknowledgement. The Registrar has discretion to scrutinize the proposed company name and objects.
required_dossiers: Acknowledgment copy of Form IC-01
Proof of government fee payment
VFSC filing fee schedule reference
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the submission is queried for missing exhibits, the registered agent must respond to the VFSC query within 10 business days with a cover letter and corrected exhibits. If the fee is deficient, pay the balance immediately. Failure to cure a query may result in refusal; the application may be resubmitted on a clean basis.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon verification of the application, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation under seal, recording the incorporation date and registration number. The company comes into existence as a body corporate on that date. The registered agent must obtain the original certificate and place it in the company's statutory records at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued by VFSC)
VFSC receipt for incorporation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If no certificate is received within the SLA, the agent follows up in writing with VFSC. Any discrepancy in name or date on the certificate must be corrected by filing an application for a Certificate of Correction. If incorporation is wrongfully refused, the subscriber may apply to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Corporate Governance, Statutory Books and AML/CFT Foundation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Office / Board of Directors / VFSC AML-CFT Supervision Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of incorporation, convene the first board meeting or adopt a unanimous written resolution to ratify share issuances, appoint officers, open bank accounts, and approve the register of members and directors. File beneficial ownership particulars with the VFSC central register as required by AML/CFT regulations, adopt an AML/CFT policy, perform a business risk assessment, and appoint an Anti-Money Laundering Compliance Officer.
required_dossiers: First board meeting minutes or written unanimous resolution
Share certificates issued to subscribers
Register of members and register of directors
Register of beneficial owners
AML/CFT policy and business risk assessment
Registered office consent and address verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If statutory records are defective, reconvene the board or obtain a written shareholders' ratification. Late amendments can be filed with the Registrar on Form IC-03 together with any prescribed late fee. Persistent non-compliance may delay the separate equity crowdfunding licence application.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Licensing and Enforcement Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Equity Crowdfunding Platform Licence issued under the Financial Dealers Act [Cap. 66] and VFSC Crowdfunding Licensing Policy 2021

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Government of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: EIA Exempt / Registration only - the activity is a wholly office-based digital intermediary; no industrial processing, substantial discharge or land disturbance occurs. If the office fit-out exceeds 200 square metres or alters building services, a separate building and environmental permit application must be submitted to DEPC.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No production wastewater or industrial emissions are permissible. Office sanitary effluent must be discharged to the municipal sewer or approved septic system in accordance with the Water Supply Act. VOC and particulate emissions from office equipment must remain within workplace ambient standards. Battery, e-waste and used toner must be forwarded to an authorized recycler. Any incidental chemical storage (cleaning agents) must be in sealed containers with spill containment and a documented emergency clean-up procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Service for the registered office floor; Certificate of Occupancy and structural load assessment from the Department of Public Works verifying wind and seismic load over server/record storage areas; and occupational health and safety clearance from the Department of Labour, including first-aid provision, emergency exit signage, worker registration and a workplace health and safety policy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (VCIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://www.customs.gov.vu (Customs & Inland Revenue). Additional registration portal for International Companies: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — https://www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu does not maintain a general national Tax Identification Number system because there is no income tax on non-resident-owned international business. A Vanuatu International Company (IC) is registered with VFSC and receives a VFSC registration number, which serves as the corporate identifier. If the IC becomes a VAT registrant (either mandatory upon taxable turnover exceeding VT 5,000,000 in any 12-month period or voluntarily), it must apply to VCIRD on Form VAT-REG-01, attaching the VFSC company extract, certificate of incorporation / registration, memorandum and articles of association, proof of registered office in Vanuatu, identity documents of directors/shareholders, bank account confirmation, and a description of the digital platform activity. After approval, VCIRD issues a VAT Registration Number (VRN) in a standard 8-digit format. For physical imports/exports, the IC must also obtain a Customs Identifier Code from VCIRD customs; no separate tax ID is otherwise required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election mechanism. An International Company under the International Companies Act Cap. 222 is conclusively exempt from all national taxes, including income tax, capital gains tax, value added tax, and imposts on foreign-sourced transactions, unless it chooses to voluntarily register for VAT to recover input tax. No pass-through election exists. The IC cannot be disregarded for tax purposes; it is a taxable person only for the narrow purpose of an optional VAT registration. There are no statutory or administrative mechanisms to elect entity-level taxation or to trigger Cló version hybrid treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under the Value Added Tax Act 2018
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (five million Vanuatu Vatu) of taxable supplies in any 12-month period; voluntary registration is permitted. For an exempt International Company engaged solely in offshore equity crowdfunding intermediation, taxable supplies in Vanuatu are generally absent or are zero-rated export services, so the threshold is not practically triggered unless the IC voluntarily registers for VAT or carries on a domestic supply in Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu has no mandatory e-invoicing, real-time tax clearance, digital stamping, or fiscal API regime as of the current legislation. VAT-registered persons must issue sequential tax invoices containing the vendor's name and address, VRN, invoice date, supply description, amount excluding VAT, VAT amount, and the zero-rating basis if applicable. Returns are filed electronically through the VCIRD taxpayer portal on a monthly or quarterly basis as directed by VCIRD. No fiscal drilling or electronic administrative pre-clearance is required; however, all records must be retained for six years for audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available under Section 21 of the VAT Act 2018 for: (a) goods exported or transferred from Vanuatu to a place outside Vanuatu; (b) services supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply, where the direct benefit of the services is received outside Vanuatu; and (c) certain international transport and ancillary supplies. An equity crowdfunding portal operated by a Vanuatu International Company is eligible to treat the platform commissions and fees charged to non-resident issuers and investors as zero-rated export services, provided the services are not attributable to any taxable activity carried on inside Vanuatu and the IC maintains evidence that the customer is non-resident and the benefit of the service is enjoyed offshore. The exemption under the IC Act may also place the supplies wholly outside the VAT net; voluntary VAT registration allows zero-rated turnover to be reported and any attributable input VAT refunded.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: VU Customs Export Declaration (Customs Form C1A) for physical goods, if applicable
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill / express courier delivery evidence for exported goods
Commercial Invoice and Packing List with full description, quantities, values, and export destination
For digital services: written service contract between the crowdfunding portal and the non-resident issuer/investor, evidencing offshore supply and offshore direct benefit

Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit/transfer record evidencing receipt of the export consideration in foreign currency (for AML and record-keeping purposes; not a statutory tax requirement in Vanuatu but conventionally retained for a 180-day compliance window)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu's VAT administration can raise assessment for uncollected output VAT within five years from the relevant tax return; where fraud or deliberate suppression is shown, there is no limitation period. If zero-rating is claimed without satisfactory export/customer evidence, VCIRD will claw back the unpaid VAT at the standard 12.5% rate and impose default interest of 1% per month, plus a civil penalty of up to 200% of the tax shortfall. Willful evasion is a criminal offence carrying fines up to VT 5,000,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years. For physical export misdeclaration under the Customs Act Cap. 256, the goods are liable to forfeiture, and the exporter may be penalized in an amount up to triple the duty evaded, with cancellation of concessions. In addition, abuse of the International Company tax-exempt status through onshore or prohibited business triggers deregistration by VFSC, revocation of the international company licence, and penalties up to VT 10,000,000 or imprisonment for directors under the International Companies Act Cap. 222.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125], acts as the central bank, prudential regulator of all licensed domestic commercial banks, and operator of the national RTGS and payments infrastructure. Concurrent supervisory authority over the equity crowdfunding portal is exercised by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the Securities Dealers (Licensing) Act [Cap. 70], the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 9 of 2022 (AML/CTF Act). The RBV has no exchange-control department and does not administer capital movement restrictions. The VFSC additionally oversees the portal's client-money trust account regime and AML/CFT compliance, including fit-and-proper reporting obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Fully liberalised de jure and de facto regime. The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for residents and non-residents on both current and capital account. Vanuatu abolished exchange controls in the 1980s; no RBV approval, registration, license, or repatriation permit is required for shareholder capital subscriptions, crowdfunding investor transfers, dividend or profit remittances, liquidation proceeds, or any other cross-border payment involving an International Company (IC). The VUV operates on a managed-float basis linked to an undisclosed basket weighted toward USD, AUD, EUR, JPY, and NZD. The IC may hold unlimited multi-currency accounts (VUV, USD, AUD, EUR) and convert between currencies without restriction. Residual practical friction is confined to commercial KYC and correspondent-bank screening; the FATF grey-list status (2021-2024) has been delisted and does not constrain convertibility. No tax-clearance, pre-remittance approval, or beneficiary declaration is required by statute.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Nil statutory regime. Vanuatu imposes no surrender quota, no mandatory conversion ratio, no repatriation timeframe, and no designated account domiciling requirement for export proceeds, service revenues, or crowdfunding facilitation fees. All foreign currency receipts may be retained indefinitely in VUV, USD, AUD, or EUR accounts at the portal's discretion. The RBV maintains no exchange-control powers that would apply to International Companies, and the IC enjoys the same non-application of any would-be surrender obligation as domestic investors. No balance-of-payments reporting is triggered by the portal's fee income.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Primary dual-account structure: (a) statutory Clients' Money Trust Account (Capital Escrow) in USD; (b) multi-currency Operating Account in VUV/USD. Strongest correspondent network (ANZ New York, ANZ Sydney) for high-volume crowdfunding flows.
Back-up Capital Escrow Account (USD) and Operating Account; viable alternative via BRED/BPCE European correspondent network, beneficial for EUR-denominated investor subscriptions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (VUV/USD) preferred for local payroll, registered agent fees, and RBV RTGS transfers; escrow custody available only with enhanced financial crime oversight.

Secondary local-operations account (VUV) for government-related levies and local disbursements; not recommended as the primary escrow bank due to state-owned governance and slower correspondent clearing.
Wealth-management discretionary account unsuitable for high-velocity crowdfunding transaction flows; minimum wallet thresholds above USD 250,000 and private-banking service model.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Moderate-Low viability. Vanuatu does not operate a dedicated e-money institution (EMI) licensing category; the VFSC does not recognise offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Currencycloud, Airwallex, Revolut Business) as compliant custodians of crowdfunding client money. Using an EMI as the principal collection or escrow rail would breach the VFSC clients'-money trust rules and the deposit-taking prohibitions of the Banking Act. An offshore EMI may be used exclusively for the portal's own operating expenses (software, marketing, hosting) and must be fully segregated from investor capital. The compliant construct is a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank holding the Capital Escrow Account, with an EMI employed only as a supplementary low-value expense account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted at all Tier-1 Vanuatu banks when a licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] presents a cover letter, certified constitutional documents, and the original Certificate of Incorporation. Each director and beneficial owner must complete a live video-conference interview with the bank's compliance officer. ANZ and BSP accept signatory verification by a Vanuatu notary or by the registered agent's senior representative in Port Vila. NBV retains discretionary authority to demand physical appearance of at least one signatory or the local agent in-branch. No statutory requirement obliges directors to travel to Vanuatu. The VFSC portal licence application itself is completed remotely through the registered agent; no physical board meeting is mandated by the IC Act.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk industry flag: 'equity crowdfunding portal' classified as a financial intermediary with third-party investor fund movements, cross-border velocity, and potential implicit money-transfer characteristics.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle: (i) VFSC Crowdfunding/Dealer Licence or a formal 'No Objection' letter evidencing the approved application; (ii) board-approved AML/CFT Programme compliant with the AML/CTF Act No. 9 of 2022 and FATF Recommendations; (iii) clients'-money trust deed and escrow accounting manual demonstrating daily segregation of investor funds; (iv) appointment certificate of a VFSC-approved AML Compliance Officer; (v) independent legal opinion confirming the portal is not a deposit-taking institution; (vi) six-month transaction volume forecast with jurisdiction breakdown of investors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ownership opacity: non-resident directors, nominee shareholder layers, or International Company structure where beneficial ownership chain is not immediately traceable.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle: (i) certified Register of Beneficial Owners maintained by the registered agent under the Companies (Amendment) Acts and VFSC beneficial-ownership rules; (ii) notarised passports, proof of address, and tax residence certificates for all natural-person UBOs holding 10% or more; (iii) source-of-wealth and source-of-funds letters supported by bank statements and corporate records for each UBO; (iv) banker's reference from the UBO's existing bank dated within the last six months; (v) ownership organogram from the portal to the ultimate individuals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-bank reputational concern: FATF grey-list history (2021-2024) may trigger zero-tolerance rejection from international correspondent banks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle: (i) official FATF delisting communication and Asia-Pacific Group (APG) mutual-evaluation follow-up report showing strategic deficiencies resolved; (ii) sanctions-screening engine certification (Dow Jones, OFAC, UNSC, and LSEG World-Check) covering the portal, all investors, and all investee companies; (iii) internal prohibition on financing sanctioned jurisdictions and a Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) decision matrix; (iv) independent chartered accountant's audit letter attesting to transaction-monitoring adequacy; (v) letter of comfort from the licensed registered agent confirming continuing compliance oversight.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party payment red flags: investor subscriptions arriving from unrelated remitters, pooled accounts, or mismatch between the remitting account holder and the declared investor identity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle: (i) sample investor KYC files (minimum five anonymised exemplars) demonstrating identity-to-wire-name matching; (ii) contractual requirement that each subscription cite a unique investor reference code in SWIFT field 70 with matching reconciliation; (iii) absolute contractual prohibition on payments from third-party or pooled payer accounts; (iv) daily reconciliation statement of the client-money account produced by the portal treasury function; (v) monthly log of Large and Unusual Transaction Reports submitted to the VFSC.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All crowdfunding subscriptions must be routed via SWIFT MT103 into the statutory Clients' Money Trust Account (Capital Escrow Account) held at ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Limited, beneficiary '[Portal Name] Investor Client Trust Account', USD account, BIC ANZBVUVX. The subscribing investor's bank must include the unique investor reference code (format VU-IC-000123-CSF) in field 70 (Remittance Information); field 72 must contain only 'BEN' for beneficiary clearing instructions. USD payments from the United States may clear through the ANZ New York correspondent (ANZBUS33) or via a domestic US bank or fintech only if funds are pre-segregated and the onward transfer references the investor code. VUV-denominated domestic transfers settle through the RBV RTGS in near real-time. Verification protocol: dual signatory release (AML Compliance Officer plus one director) is required before any escrow-to-operating transfer; investor funds may never be co-mingled with operating balances; daily reconciliation against the trust deed and VFSC reporting calendar must be maintained. No RBV exchange-control approval or filing form is required for inbound capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements from escrow to investee companies settle via three clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 (default) for equity funding, milestone payments, and distribution of returns, with the escrow release instruction number quoted in field 70; (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600, irrevocable, at-sight) where the investee requires documentary trade settlement; (iii) Vanuatu RTGS VUV transfers for on-island disbursements. USD payments clear via ANZ New York or ANZ Sydney USD clearing accounts; AUD via RITS; EUR via the BRED/BPCE Paris network. Each disbursement must be pre-authorised by an investment committee minute compliant with VFSC conditions. Standard bank-imposed limits: USD 1,000,000 per day per beneficiary without extended financial crime review; larger sums require 24-hour prior no-objection from the bank's financial crime unit. No exchange-control approval and no tax clearance certificate is required under Vanuatu law for International Company outward remittances.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable foreign exchange forwards (30, 90, 180, and 360-day tenors) in VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, VUV/EUR, and VUV/JPY quoted by ANZ, BRED, and BSP for hedging operating expenses and escrow milestone obligations.

Offshore Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on the VUV executed through Singapore or Hong Kong desks of international banks, used when traditional deliverable VUV liquidity is insufficient for the portal's hedging requirements.
Cross-currency swaps (VUV/USD and VUV/AUD) with Reserve Bank of Vanuatu-authorised commercial banks, suitable for long-dated exposure matching escrow liability duration.
Strategic multi-currency sinking-fund deposits in USD, AUD, and VUV enabling the portal to avoid proprietary FX risk while maintaining budgeted VUV conversion corridors with stop-loss discipline.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of each calendar anniversary of the company's incorporation date or the anniversary specified in the International Companies (Amendment) Act and VFSC directives
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VUV 10,000 (approx. USD 85) for the first month, VUV 5,000 (approx. USD 42) per additional month or part thereof, with continued default triggering administrative strike-off after notice under the International Companies Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Declaration of Solvency or Non-Solicitation Status (if required upon renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted annually to support the license and registration renewal, on or before the anniversary of the register of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may result in suspension of the company's registration and capacity to carry on activities, and ultimately strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Equity Crowdfunding Portal License Annual Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Securities Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the license anniversary date, typically 31 December or the renewal date prescribed by the VFSC licensing regime, with a 30-day grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: License lapse if unrenewed; continued unlicensed operation constitutes a breach of the Companies and Securities legislation, attracting daily penalties up to VUV 5,000 (approx. USD 42) per day and potential revocation of the license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Compliance Return (Evidence of Registered Agent and Compliance Officer Oversight)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) AML/CFT Supervision Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 45 days of the entity's financial year-end, or as specified in the VFSC AML/CFT Directive applicable to licensed intermediaries
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty up to VUV 5 million (approx. USD 42,000) for material breaches; suspension or revocation of the crowdfunding license for non-filing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A licensed equity crowdfunding portal operated as a Vanuatu International Company is required to have its financial statements independently audited annually when the entity's annual turnover or balance-sheet value exceeds VUV 100 million (approx. USD 850,000), or when the VFSC directs an audit in the interest of investors, or when the entity is a public-interest licensee; otherwise, an internal independent review is acceptable.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (adopted as Vanuatu Financial Reporting Standards generally aligned with IFRS) or, for smaller non-public entities, the VFSC-prescribed simplified local GAAP regime consistent with the International Companies Act and VFSC reporting guidelines.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must file an annual confirmation via its registered agent confirming no change in ultimate beneficial ownership during the preceding year; any share transfer during the year must be recorded in the share register and the UBO register kept at the registered office. The confirmation is due with the annual return within 30 days of the incorporation anniversary. The VFSC may require disclosure of ultimate beneficial owners on request, and sanctions apply for omission.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book
Register of Issued Shares and Share Transfers

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu International Companies are statutorily exempt from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, and withholding tax under the International Companies Act 1992. There is no taxable profit concept and no statutory tax holiday regime, because the base rate is already nil. Annual compliance charges comprise solely the government renewal fee scaled by authorised capital and the registered agent's professional fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return form exists in Vanuatu for International Companies. The only recurring fiscal filing is the International Company annual government fee renewal, processed by the licensed registered agent via the VFSC online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation; International Companies Act 1992, ss. 55-56 require the government fee to be paid by that date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and VFSC International Company registration number of the portal entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners hold no Vanuatu tax identification number and are not required to obtain one; the registered agent confirms the exact registered name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Stated authorised capital determines the annual government fee band.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital is prescribed; non-resident shareholders may leave capital at nominal levels, but escrow capacity and crowdfunding licence thresholds must be respected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Registered Agent Declaration and Beneficial Ownership File
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Agent attests that the IC maintains a current register of directors and beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident UBO list must be physically held by the Vanuatu registered agent, not publicly filed; failure to maintain this file is an immediate strike-off ground.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late government fee attracts a penalty of 10% of the fee plus a further 10% for each month or part of a month of default; continuing non-payment leads to administrative strike-off and dissolution of the IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return for relevant activities, filed online through the VFSC filing module via the registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of the IC's financial year, or by the date stipulated by the VFSC for the relevant filing window.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The IC must declare whether it performs a relevant activity; equity crowdfunding portal operation is treated as financial intermediation/financing activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must identify the exact activity code and confirm the business is conducted for foreign clients only, consistent with the IC no-resident-business restriction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B - Core Income-Generating Activities in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Specifies where strategic decisions, platform management, contracting, and client onboarding actually occur.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If decisions are made by non-resident promoters offshore, the IC will fail the economic substance test and face penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section C - Local Employees and Premises
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Discloses number of full-time employees, physical office address, and whether the registered agent's office is used.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A mere shell office or virtual address will not satisfy the substance test; at least one locally employed compliance officer and a dedicated suite are expected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provides the annual operating expenditure incurred in Vanuatu, including payroll, rent, systems, and compliance costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenditure must be proportionate to the crowdfunding revenue class; a nil-expenditure return is a fatal red flag.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or false filing of the Economic Substance Return attracts a fixed financial penalty plus a daily compounding fine for continued default; severe cases result in deregistration and director disqualification.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network applicable to International Companies. Because the domestic statutory withholding rate is 0%, no treaty relief application or Tax Residency Certificate procedure is required before a dividend, interest, or royalty payment is remitted to a non-resident investor. The registered agent simply issues the corporate resolution and payment instruction; the recipient's foreign tax affairs are governed by the investor's own jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on cross-border royalties and 0% on interest payments; absent any DTA, the same nil rate applies to payments to all foreign jurisdictions, including license fees for platform software and escrow interest distributions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A - Vanuatu has not enacted a transfer pricing documentation statute, and no Local File or Master File threshold in Vanuatu Vatu exists. The arm's length principle is nonetheless applied as a soft-law standard where the IC transacts with related parties in jurisdictions that enforce OECD transfer pricing rules.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations apply to a Vanuatu International Company earning income from relevant activities. Equity crowdfunding portal operation falls within financial intermediation/financing. The IC must demonstrate in Vanuatu: adequate physical premises, proportionate full-time local employees, real operating expenditure, and board management/control. A passive booking entity with no local substance will fail the ESR assessment and become subject to penalty and strike-off action initiated by the VFSC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an equity crowdfunding portal without obtaining the relevant VFSC securities/investment intermediary licence, or conducting public solicitation with Vanuatu-resident investors despite the International Company's statutory prohibition on trading with residents.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal offence under the International Companies Act 1992 and Vanuatu licensing legislation: fine up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 6 months; the VFSC may strike off the IC, freeze escrow accounts, and restrain bank wires.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for investor losses; the corporate veil is pierced for deliberate unlicensed trading. Directors face civil restitution orders, court-issued travel bans preventing departure from Vanuatu, and custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu 0% tax regime to conceal taxable economic ownership or to fabricate foreign management fees, IP royalties, or escrow deductions while the effective management and revenue sit in a high-tax jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu applies mutual legal assistance and information-exchange instruments enabling foreign revenue authorities to obtain books, bank records, and UBO data; false declarations to the VFSC attract fines up to VUV 500,000 with escalation, and confiscation orders may attach to escrow balances.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Fraud and false-pretence charges permit full veil piercing; directors may be ordered to make civil restitution of all misdirected funds, subjected to travel bans pending criminal proceedings, and imprisoned for up to 7 years under the Vanuatu Penal Code.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement anti-money laundering controls: no customer due diligence, no statutory record-keeping on ACH escrow and bank-wire transactions, no suspicious transaction reporting to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, and no designated compliance officer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2018: corporate fines up to VUV 25,000,000; individual fines up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 10 years for money laundering; VFSC licence revocation and targeted financial sanctions may follow.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally accountable for systemic AML failure; civil restitution to defrauded investors is ordered, travel bans are imposed while investigations are pending, and imprisonment applies upon conviction for laundering crowdfunding proceeds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the crowdfunding portal as a pure shell: no Vanuatu office, no local staff, no local operational expenditure, and nominee directors signing the Economic Substance Return without verifying actual activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic substance non-compliance triggers a fixed penalty of VUV 500,000 plus a daily compounding penalty of VUV 50,000; continuing default leads to strike-off, forfeiture of the registered agent's services, and deregistration of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for knowingly filing false ESR declarations; the corporate veil is pierced for unpaid regulatory penalties and creditor claims. Courts may issue travel bans to secure attendance, and directors face disqualification and imprisonment for false statements.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Advertising the portal as VFSC-regulated when no licence exists, guaranteeing startup equity returns, commingling investor escrow funds with operating revenue, or creating fabricated issuers to collect crowdfunding payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Theft and false-pretence offences under the Vanuatu Penal Code: imprisonment up to 7 years per offence; fraudulent trading and breach of the Financial Dealers Act expose the company to restitution orders, winding-up, and seizure of assets held in escrow accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed or authorised fraudulent campaign materials become personally and criminally liable; civil restitution to every victim is mandatory, travel bans are issued upon charge, and imprisonment is imposed on conviction, with no possibility of corporate veil protection.
